label: Они
description: Third-person plural sentences that train plural verb forms and how nouns behave around them.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural motion. 1. 'Они' marks a plural third-person subject. 2. 'Идут' is the correct plural form of motion on foot. 3. 'Домой' keeps the destination form natural and common.

Strategic focus: Plural present tense. 1. 'Читают' is the proper third-person plural form. 2. 'Книгу' remains a clear direct object. 3. This sentence is great for hearing the difference between singular and plural verb endings.
Strategic focus: Group action. 1. 'Пишут' is the plural present form of 'писать'. 2. 'Письмо' is a stable object and easy to picture. 3. This line reinforces that plural subjects need plural verbs.

Strategic focus: Perception in plural. 1. 'Видят' is the third-person plural form. 2. 'Стол' stays as a simple visible object. 3. This sentence makes the plural ending obvious while keeping the noun side very simple.

Strategic focus: Shared evaluation. 1. 'Любят' is the plural form that contrasts with 'любит'. 2. 'Этот дом' is a masculine noun phrase. 3. This sentence is useful for internalizing plural subject agreement.

Strategic focus: Irregular plural present tense. 1. 'Едят' is the correct third-person plural form. 2. 'Хлеб' is a practical object noun. 3. This sentence is especially important because the verb is irregular and very common.
Strategic focus: Survival and plural agreement. 1. 'Пьют' is the plural form of 'пить'. 2. 'Воду' stays in accusative as the object. 3. This sentence is practical and easy to reuse in real speech.
Strategic focus: Negation in plural. 1. 'Не' negates the verb. 2. 'Понимают' is the correct plural form. 3. This sentence is highly useful in live interaction and group settings.
Strategic focus: Plural desire. 1. 'Хотят' is the plural present form of 'хотеть'. 2. 'Кофе' is a concrete and familiar object. 3. This sentence is useful because it sounds natural and immediate.

Strategic focus: Plural activity and location. 1. 'Работают' is the third-person plural present form. 2. 'Дома' stays as a stable location word. 3. This sentence shows how the verb changes while the place word remains the same.

Strategic focus: Collective language use. 1. 'Говорят' is the plural form. 2. 'По-русски' is the natural adverbial form for language use. 3. This sentence is one of the best identity-building lines for learners.

Strategic focus: Group knowledge. 1. 'Знают' is third-person plural. 2. 'Это' is the thing known or referenced. 3. The sentence is short but ideal for seeing subject-verb agreement in a very clear frame.

Strategic focus: Taking an object. 1. 'Берут' is the plural present form. 2. 'Книгу' is the object being taken. 3. This sentence is useful because it keeps the noun side stable while the verb changes.

Strategic focus: Physical action. 1. 'Открывают' is the correct plural form. 2. 'Дверь' is a simple and clear object. 3. This sentence is good for repetition because it is vivid and easy to understand.

Strategic focus: Perception in plural. 1. 'Слышат' is the third-person plural form. 2. 'Музыку' is the heard object in accusative. 3. This sentence is useful for teaching the plural version of a familiar perception pattern.
Strategic focus: Pronoun object form. 1. 'Видят' is plural third person. 2. 'Меня' is the object form of 'я'. 3. This sentence reinforces that pronouns change shape when they are objects.
Strategic focus: Routine collective action. 1. 'Делают' is a common plural present form. 2. 'Чай' keeps the object practical and familiar. 3. This sentence is simple and useful for rapid review.
Strategic focus: Carrying. 1. 'Несут' is the correct plural present form. 2. 'Сумку' is the carried object. 3. This sentence is helpful because it makes the plural verb ending very visible.

Strategic focus: Finding something. 1. 'Находят' is third-person plural. 2. 'Ключ' is a familiar object. 3. This sentence is practical and reinforces the singular/plural contrast in a high-frequency verb.

Strategic focus: Verb governance and prepositional case. 1. 'Думают' is the plural form. 2. 'О работе' shows the prepositional form after 'о'. 3. This sentence is excellent for teaching how verbs shape the case of surrounding nouns.
